name: Backsplash Installation
summary: Professional kitchen backsplash installation with subway tile, glass mosaic, patterned tile, hexagon tile, decorative accents and clean finishing around cabinets, outlets and countertops.

faqs.question: How long does a kitchen backsplash installation usually take?
faqs.answer: Many standard backsplash projects can be completed in about two days, although detailed patterns, repairs, specialty materials or extensive cuts may require additional time.

faqs.question: Can backsplash tile be installed around existing cabinets and countertops?
faqs.answer: Yes. The layout can be measured and cut around cabinets, countertops, outlets, switches, windows and appliances for a finished installation without replacing the entire kitchen.

faqs.question: What backsplash materials can Luna General Contractors install?
faqs.answer: Common options include ceramic and porcelain subway tile, glass mosaic, marble-look tile, hexagon tile, patterned tile and decorative accent pieces.
